services.desc: Welcome to the Riverview Workshops at the Bridgeport Art Center - a collective, membership-based workspace designed for urban makers. Our community includes woodworkers, glass artists, metal craftspeople, and other hands-on creators who need room to experiment, build, and grow. City living has its advantages, but spacious studios are rarely one of them. Riverview Workshops provides space, tools, and collaborative environment makers need to thrive. services.desc: ArtConnectED understands the importance of building community and the role the arts play in bringing people together. Art Connection: Past Meets Present celebrates the enduring connections between art educators and their former students, honoring the shared creative journey that begins in the classroom and continues throughout a lifetime. This exhibition showcases the impact of mentorship, inspiration, and the lasting influence that teachers and students have on one another. Through a variety of media and artistic voices, the show highlights how creative dialogue and exploration can span years, evolve, and continue to inspire new perspectives. Awards are generously provided by BLICK Art
